examples.english: And the holy man Demetrius said unto the Angel, 'What is it, O my Lord? What is it that Thou wouldst command me to do? If Thou wishest to send me forth to martyrdom, am I not ready to pour out my blood for the Name of my Lord Jesus the Christ?'
examples.source: Encomium on Demetrius Archbishop of Alexandria part 1

examples.english: If He was, why wast not thou brought to the ground when they poured out in the midst of thee the blood of Zecharias?
examples.source: Proclus Homily 13 on Easter in Budge ed.

examples.coptic: **ⲁⲩⲡⲱϩⲧ **ⲉⲃⲟⲗ**** ⲙⲡⲉⲩⲥⲛⲟϥ · ⲉϫⲛⲧϩⲟⲙⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ ⲙⲡⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ · ⲁⲩⲱ ⲁⲩϫⲓ ⲙⲡⲉⲕⲗⲟⲙ ⲛⲧⲙⲛⲧⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ ·
examples.english: They poured out their blood in their confession of God, and they received the crown of martyrdom.
